_note: THE INDUSTRIAL FAMILY, 4 OF 10: THE COOLANT PUMPS.
Two coolant pumps failed and the plant is too hot to restart. Bring the engineer's toolbox in, fix both pumps in
any order, and hold the room while the system bleeds. The verb is FIX.
Industrial dungeons (LocTypeDungeon_ThemeIndustrial, 20 per Eliza's count), vanilla interiors that carry the
delve markers today. Every word holds in any of them: nothing names the site, the faction or what the plant
made; everything a line points at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Industrial dungeons; the delve marker set.

prose.name: Repairs: Coolant Pumps on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The <Place> can't restart until its coolant pumps are fixed, and the engineer who could fix them won't go back in.
prose.card: Local Contract. Repair the two coolant pumps at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The engineer left her toolbox at the door, with a note taped to the lid: pumps, both, inside. Take your time. I need to fix both pumps.
beats.name: Engineer's Toolbox

beats.journal: One pump fixed. The seal had perished, years ago by the look of it.
beats.name: Coolant Pump

beats.journal: One pump fixed. Somebody had kicked it, hard, more than once. It works now.
beats.name: Backup Coolant Pump

beats.objective: Hold the room while the system bleeds
beats.journal: Both pumps at the <Place> are fixed and the system bled through clean. The plant can restart.
say: Pressure's coming up on both. That's lovely, they'll hold now.

broadcast: My toolbox is by the door. Two pumps inside, both dead. Fix them and then give the system time to bleed. And don't rush it. A rushed pump is a broken pump.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
